description: For a video or reel you made, omit account_ids and never ask which accounts: it saves as a project, the person is told it is ready and picks accounts and a time in the app (no post_myself, post_schedule or post_submit). Otherwise draft a post for one or more accounts. A person approves each draft in the app, unless this connection may publish what it submits (whoami: auto_approve), when submit=true approves it at once (TikTok and YouTube still wait for a person); otherwise submit=true sends it to the approval queue. With no scheduled_at, each account takes its next best slot (see each target's time_reason). Pass scheduled_at to pick the time, or next_slot=false for none. series_id makes it the series' next episode. A video edited in Edits goes in as one upload (media_upload_url); put the Edits project name in title so a re-edit can reopen it. Edits library music is cleared for Instagram and Facebook only, so leave other networks off a post that carries it.

account_group_id.description: A posting group from account_groups_list: post to all its accounts (plus any account_ids).

account_ids.description: Accounts from accounts_list; with account_group_id, added to the group's. Leave it empty for a video or reel you made: it saves as a project and the person is told it is ready and picks the accounts. Never ask them which accounts. The iPhone's editor saves projects the same way; post_create with its post_id and accounts makes it a post

also_trial_reel.description: Also post the Instagram Reel as a Trial Reel: a linked second post (kind trial_reel) with the same media and caption and its own test name, scheduled at the same time, approved together with this one and shown as one card with two badges. Needs kind or network_kinds.instagram to be reel, and Instagram's Trial Reel not locked for the account

trial_graduation.description: How the Trial Reel graduates to followers. Default MANUAL

trial_test.description: The test's name (Instagram's Trial Reel test); left out, the Trial Reel has none

caption.description: Post text, as it should appear, e.g. "New menu starts Friday"

episode.description: Only to override the episode number.

highlight_ids.description: Stories: the Highlight each Instagram account files it in (see highlights_list); [] clears them.

hook_seconds.description: With script: how long its opening line runs in the video, in seconds

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

kind.description: reel, trial_reel (Instagram), image, carousel, video, story (Instagram: one photo or video, no caption), or text (Threads, Facebook, LinkedIn, Bluesky, Mastodon and Google Business Profile: words only, no media; a link in a LinkedIn or Bluesky text post shows as a card)

media_ids.description: Ready media from media_list, in order. Up to 20 for a Threads or LinkedIn carousel; Instagram and Facebook take 10, Bluesky 4 photos.

network_kinds.description: One post, mixed formats: the format each network takes when it isn't kind, keyed by network, e.g. {instagram:"reel", facebook:"reel", youtube:"reel", threads:"video", tiktok:"video"} or {threads:"text"} (words only, no media for that network). Each network must take its format. null takes a network back to kind. All accounts stay on one post

next_slot.description: Left out: an account with no time takes its next best slot (its best time from its own numbers, else its posting times or its network's usual hours), keeping its quiet days, daily cap and 45 minutes from its other posts. true: every account takes its next free slot (an error when four weeks are full). false: no time is picked, so the post has none until one is set.

options.description: Per-network options, e.g. {instagram:{trial_graduation:"MANUAL", trial_test:"Spring hooks", first_comment, collaborators, alt_text, cover_media_id, is_ai_generated}}, {tiktok:{privacy_level}}, {linkedin:{alt_text, link_title}}, {bluesky:{alt_text}}, {mastodon:{visibility, spoiler_text, alt_text}} or {pinterest:{board_id, title, link, alt_text}}, {google_business:{post_type (whats_new, offer, event), button, link, title, starts, ends, coupon_code, terms}} (alt_text: text for one photo or video, or a list with one entry per photo). Every Mastodon, Pinterest and Google Business Profile option has a default

post_id.description: A draft to fill in place instead of making a new post, such as the one the iPhone's video editor saves so its edit can sync. Every account on it must still be a draft. Its video edit stays.

post_myself.description: Only when the person told you to post by hand on specific accounts; agents never pick these on their own. Accounts (from account_ids) that a person posts to by hand in the network's app, e.g. for trending audio or Story stickers. Still approved like any post; at its time the team gets a "Time to post" reminder with the media and caption instead of Chockstone publishing it.

products.description: What the post is about, from a product link: each saved with what earns on it, {link} in the caption, the products on the link page and its Shop the post tile (on_bio), a collection, and a Story with the link to follow. Undo takes back the post, new links and the page change.

collection_id.description: A collection from bio_collections_list for the products. Left out: the likely one, if any

collection_title.description: Or a collection by title, made when there's none

in_post.description: The link in the caption: {link} is added when the caption leaves it out, and each network gets its own words for it

keyword.description: With in_post, a word people comment on Instagram to get the link by DM: the caption says "Comment SKILLET" and an auto-reply for it is made with the post on each Instagram account (needs the comments and dm permissions; one already sending the same link is used again). Other networks get "Link in bio" or the link

on_bio.description: The products on the link page: its list, the post's Shop the post tile once it's out, and a collection

story.description: Once it's out on Instagram, a Story to post yourself with a link sticker (the API can't add one): the team gets a reminder with the link to paste

urls.description: Product pages (Amazon, a brand's shop, anywhere), saved as links with what earns on them: your Associates tag, a joined brand program's code. One already saved is reused

publish.description: For a person who may approve (the iPhone and web composers in a workspace of one): approve it as it is made, so no second step. schedule: approved at its time or next best slot. now: approved and published at once. Needs a signed-in person with publish permission; connections use submit

scheduled_at.description: When it goes out once approved. ISO 8601: with an offset it is that moment; without one (2026-11-02T09:00) it is that clock time in the post's time zone.

script.description: The recorder's prompter script, when the video was read from one: its first line is the post's hook (how it opens, for insights_get hooks). Not kept.

series_id.description: Series from series_list; the post gets the next episode number.

shop_link_ids.description: Products (links from links_list) for its Shop the post sheet on the bio page, in order. Joins the bio page's grid once published. Change them later with post_links_set.

submit.description: true also sends it for approval in the same call; default false

timezone.description: The post's own time zone (IANA, e.g. Asia/Tokyo) for a post that should go out at a clock time somewhere else; null follows the workspace's. Left out, it stays as it is (a new post follows the workspace).

title.description: Internal name. Defaults to the caption's start.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: post_create
title: Draft a post
